title: Vegan Mushroom Pho with Tofu and Herbs
summary: A fragrant Vietnamese-style noodle soup with a deeply savoury mushroom broth, tender rice noodles, golden tofu and fresh herbs. It is warming, light and ideal for a vegan dinner.
steps: Heat a large dry pot over medium-high heat. Add the halved onion and sliced ginger cut-side down and char for 4–5 minutes, turning once, until dark golden and fragrant.
Add the garlic, cinnamon and cardamom to the pot and toast for 1 minute, stirring, until aromatic but not burnt.
Pour in the vegetable stock, then add the soy sauce, brown sugar, salt and black pepper. Bring to a boil, reduce to a gentle simmer and cook for 25 minutes to infuse the broth.
Meanwhile, heat 1 tbsp vegetable oil in a frying pan over medium-high heat. Add the tofu cubes and cook for 8–10 minutes, turning occasionally, until golden on several sides. Set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tbsp vegetable oil to the same pan. Fry the shiitake and button mushrooms for 6–8 minutes until browned, softened and any liquid has mostly evaporated.
Cook the rice noodles according to the packet instructions, usually soaking or simmering for 4–6 minutes until tender but not mushy. Drain and rinse briefly with warm water.

Strain the broth to remove the onion, ginger, garlic and spices, then return the clear broth to the pot. Add the fried mushrooms and simmer for 3 minutes. Taste and adjust with a little more salt if needed.
Divide the noodles between four bowls. Top with golden tofu, then ladle over the hot mushroom broth.
Finish each bowl with spring onions, coriander, mint, bean sprouts, chilli slices and lime wedges. Serve immediately while the broth is steaming hot.
